harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, /tmp and /dev/shm are now mounted as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab entries. Verified functionally (blocked script execution in both locations) before and after a full node reboot, confirming the hardening survives reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline mount state for /tmp and /dev/shm and /etc/fstab on node1
Backed up /etc/fstab, removed any prior /tmp or /dev/shm fstab lines, added tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with noexec,nosuid,nodev options
Reloaded systemd and mounted /tmp (newly) and remounted /dev/shm with the new options
Verified via findmnt that both mounts show noexec,nosuid,nodev
Functionally verified exec is blocked on both /tmp and /dev/shm via a test script that fails with Permission denied
Captured pre-restart boot_id and mount state baseline
Issued a non-interactive reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified findmnt, fstab entries, and functional exec-blocking on /tmp and /dev/shm post-restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before changes (mounts, fstab, boot id)
evidence.summary: Captured initial boot_id, showed /tmp had no dedicated mount and /dev/shm lacked noexec, and fstab had no /tmp or /dev/shm entries.

evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm configured with noexec,nosuid,nodev and fstab updated for persistence
evidence.summary: Added fstab entries, remounted both filesystems, and findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both /tmp and /dev/shm; functional test scripts in both locations failed with Permission denied.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline for restart protocol
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (8336c3a1...) and confirmed both mounts and fstab entries were in the hardened state prior to reboot.
Issued backgrounded non-interactive reboot; command returned REBOOT_ACK_SENT before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Node unreachable during restart, then command execution restored
evidence.summary: First poll showed connection refused (node rebooting); second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (51d306f6...), proving the node came back up with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: fstab-driven mount options persisted and are functionally enforced
evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt on /tmp and /dev/shm both show rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec sourced from the persisted /etc/fstab entries, and functional exec tests in both locations again failed with Permission denied, confirming the hardening survived the reboot.

attempts.summary: On node1, /tmp and /dev/shm are now mounted as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab entries. Verified functionally (blocked script execution in both locations) before and after a full node reboot, confirming the hardening survives reboot.
